description: This file contains the implementation of a PHP class 'Stash' which acts as a client for the STASH (Bitbucket Server) REST API. It provides methods to interact with repositories, projects, users, branches, commits, and repository content, encapsulating API requests and responses.

classes.name: Stash
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the STASH REST API, handling authentication, connection setup, and API requests for user, project, repository, branch, commit, and repository content management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Stash client with configuration parameters, sets up the request object, and performs configuration validation.

methods.name: configCheck
methods.description: Validates essential configuration properties like host, username, and password, throwing exceptions if they are missing.

methods.name: testLogin
methods.description: Tests the login credentials by attempting to retrieve the user and checking request status.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves user information for a given username via REST API call.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Fetches a list of accessible projects from the server.

methods.name: getRepos
methods.description: Retrieves repositories within a project, optionally filtering by repository name.

methods.name: getRepoContent
methods.description: Fetches contents of a repository at a specified path, branch, or commit.

methods.name: getBranches
methods.description: Lists branches of a specific repository.

methods.name: getCommits
methods.description: Retrieves commit history for a repository, optionally filtered by branch.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific project by its key.

search-terms: PHP REST client for Bitbucket Server
